newsitem.title: PHILIPPINES: Redeco to hike authorised capital stock.
newsitem.headline: Redeco to hike authorised capital stock.

text.p: Republic Resources and Development Corp (Redeco) said on Friday its board had approved the increase in the company's authorised capital stock to 20 billion pesos from one billion pesos.
In a statement to the Philippine Stock Exchange, it said its board also cleared the company's conversion into a holding company.
The firm has slated a special stockholders' meet on February 24 to approve the amendments.
